name: Constraint Relaxation Mapping
description: Replaced explicit zero-time/zero-phase descriptions with formal scheduling constraint relaxations. Instead of explicitly stating that a phase is "waived" or takes "0 time," the problem defines four explicit scheduling constraints and asks which scenario remains impossible when specific constraints are waived. Models must logically deduce that waiving precedence and one server's capacity reduces the remaining feasibility check to a simple sum of the other server's processing times.
